test_extension_shapes: test the raymarcher output shapes by running pytest on test_extension_shapes to verify rayrgb and rayalpha tensor dimensions
compute_raydirs: compute ray positions, directions, and t-min/max from camera intrinsics, extrinsics, and pixel coordinates using compute_raydirs
load_camera_calibration: load camera calibration data from a JSON file using load_camera_calibration to get intrinsics and extrinsics for a given camera ID
raymarcher_OSS: run the OSS raymarcher with ray positions, directions, t-min/max, and decoded output to produce ray RGB and alpha images
raydirs_fixture: generate ray directions and positions for a given image shape and camera calibration using the raydirs pytest fixture
